pokedexEntries.sw: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

pokedexEntries.sh: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

pokedexEntries.sc: It stores berries in its cheeks. When there are no berries to be found, Skwovet will stuff pebbles into its cheeks to stave off its cravings.

pokedexEntries.vi: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.
